parsed.g: Mark all Hollister shirts on sale in the Magento Admin catalog by setting a sale price (special price) on them
P_t: Navigated to the Magento Admin Catalog > Products page
Searched for 'Hollister' products using the keyword search, resulting in 16 records found
Identified that the 16 Hollister products include sweatshirts and their variants (configurable and simple products)
R_t: Filter the 16 Hollister results to identify only shirts (not sweatshirts or other product types)
Select all Hollister shirt products using the header checkbox or individual checkboxes
Use the 'Update attributes' bulk action to set a special/sale price on all selected Hollister shirts, OR navigate to each shirt product individually and set a special price
Save the changes to mark the shirts as on sale
parsed.e_t: The agent is on the Magento Admin Products page (http://172.185.52.29:7780/admin/catalog/product/) with an active keyword filter 'Hollister' showing 16 records. The product list shows Hollister Backyard Sweatshirt (configurable, ID 126), Hollister Backyard Sweatshirt-XS-Red (simple, ID 112), Hollister Backyard Sweatshirt-S-White (simple, ID 116), and more. No products are currently selected (all checkboxes unchecked). The filter panel is not expanded. There is a duplicate table structure visible in the DOM (tables [5836] and [3262]).
C: Must mark only Hollister shirts (not all Hollister products) on sale — the task specifies 'shirts'
Marking 'on sale' in Magento requires setting a Special Price on each product, which can be done via 'Update attributes' bulk action or individual product edit
No products are currently selected, so bulk actions cannot be applied until products are selected

F_t.action: Typed 'Hollister' in the Name filter field and clicked Apply Filters at step 5
F_t.cause: The filter panel still had a Quantity filter (2-3) active from a previous state, so the combined filter (Name: Hollister AND Quantity: 2-3) returned 0 records as shown in the DOM ('We couldn't find any records.')

F_t.action: Clicked 'Clear all' button [4386] at step 6 to clear filters
F_t.cause: This cleared the Name:Hollister filter along with the Quantity filter, resulting in the active filter showing only Name:Hollister after the keyword search was applied separately — the agent intended to clear only the quantity filter but cleared all filters

F_t.action: Clicked header checkbox [3534] multiple times (steps 8, 10, 12) to select all products
F_t.cause: Per DOM evidence, all row checkboxes remain unchecked (checked: false) after these clicks, indicating the select-all checkbox did not successfully select products — the actions may have toggled without registering, or the checkbox behavior required a different interaction

F_t.action: Clicked 'Update attributes' [4198] at step 11 without any products selected
F_t.cause: No products were selected (all checkboxes show checked: false in DOM), so the bulk action could not be applied to any products

F_t.action: Clicked individual product checkboxes [25548] and [25598] at steps 14-15
F_t.cause: Per DOM at step 16, both checkboxes [25548] and [25598] still show checked: false, indicating the clicks did not register as selections

F_t.action: Clicked 'product-filters' button [4908] at steps 17, 18, 20 to open filter panel
F_t.cause: The filter panel did not visibly expand in the DOM observations — the button click toggled but no new filter input fields appeared in subsequent observations, suggesting the panel may not have opened or the agent was clicking the wrong element

Per DOM at step 20, the active filter still shows 'Keyword: Hollister', meaning the clear all did not remove the filter — the filter persisted, possibly because the agent was interacting with a stale or duplicate UI element

K_t: Searching 'Hollister' by keyword returns 16 records total
The 16 Hollister products visible include 'Hollister Backyard Sweatshirt' (configurable, ID 126, SKU MH05) and its simple product variants (XS-Red ID 112, S-White ID 116, etc.)
The products shown are sweatshirts — the agent needs to find Hollister shirts specifically

The header checkbox [3534] or [5844] can be used to select all visible products, but attempts have not successfully checked products
